newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore stock exchange closed on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Singapore stock exchange closed on Monday.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Singapore was closed on Monday for the Moslem's Eid Al-Fitr public holiday.
The exchange's last day of trade was on Thursday when it closed early ahead of Friday's Lunar New Year festivities.
At the 0430 GMT close on Friday, the key Straits Times Industrials Index was up 7.61 points at 2,203.39 on traded volume of 151.5 million shares showing 221 gainers against 81 losers.
Malaysian over-the-counter stocks were the most active led by MBF Holdings.
Asia Pacific Breweries topped gainers, up 45 cents to Singapore $8.30, but with low volume.
Shares in Creative Technology saw the biggest fall, down 40 cents at S$19.20.
Trading resumes in Singapore shares at 0100 GMT on Tuesday.
